evaluations.rationale: The broad plan remains valid: it names parity, a local fixture, a repair, and a regression route. It is deferred in favor of the generated casing matrix because that candidate is the smallest test that discriminates the competing causes.

Selected. It directly discriminates a missing name rule from casing and fetch-path effects with one bounded matrix and includes the same-origin control. The baseline result already supports the expected pattern.

Deferred, not refuted. Array storage is a plausible bypass, but the baseline used object headers and had already produced a leak, so this candidate cannot be the primary explanation. It is folded into the selected matrix as a control.

Deferred, not refuted. Post-sanitization injection is a distinct mechanism, but internal instrumentation is more invasive than observing destination headers and is unnecessary while a missing name rule explains the same evidence.
Deferred, not refuted. The same-origin control is essential for repair validation but does not explain the cross-origin leak. It is included in the selected matrix so one action covers both.
Deferred, not refuted. Cross-API parity and 307 coverage are useful later regression work but require a candidate patch first, so this candidate belongs to a later round.
